name: Holy Roman Empire (as a body; Reich, imperial army or Reichsarmee)
Republic of Venice
note: VEN is taken by Venezuela in COW, so VNC is used.

name: Kingdom (Sultanate) of Mysore
note: End year marks the end of independent rule (fall of Seringapatam 1799).

name: Habsburg Monarchy / Austrian Empire
note: Used for the Austrian Habsburg monarchy, including when the Habsburg ruler acted as Holy Roman Emperor.

name: Baden
note: Margraviate, then Electorate and Grand Duchy, of Baden.

name: Bavaria
note: Electorate (from 1806 Kingdom) of Bavaria, before COW's 1816 start.

name: Denmark-Norway
note: Used for the united Danish-Norwegian monarchy until 1814.

name: France
note: Used for the Kingdom, the Republic and the Empire of France.

name: Brandenburg-Prussia / Prussia
note: Used for Brandenburg-Prussia and the Kingdom of Prussia (COW 'Germany' successor).

name: Hanover
note: Electorate of Brunswick-Luneburg (Hanover), in personal union with Britain from 1714.

name: Hesse-Kassel
note: Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel (COW 'Hesse Electoral').

name: Persia (Qajar Iran)
note: Used for Persia; Peru holds the code PER in COW.

name: Savoy / Kingdom of Sardinia
note: Used for the Duchy of Savoy (Piedmont) and, from 1720, the Kingdom of Sardinia (COW 'Italy' predecessor).

name: Modena
note: Duchy of Modena (acceded to Aix-la-Chapelle 1748).

name: Dutch Republic / Batavian Republic / United Netherlands
note: Used for the United Provinces, the Batavian Republic (1795-1806) and the United Netherlands from 1813-15.

name: Portugal
note: Used for the Kingdom of Portugal.

name: Tsardom of Russia / Russian Empire
note: Used for Muscovy/Tsardom of Russia and the Russian Empire.

name: Saxony
note: Electorate (from 1806 Kingdom) of Saxony; Augustus II/III were also Kings of Poland.

name: Kingdom of Naples / Two Sicilies
note: Used for the Bourbon Kingdom of Naples (and Sicily).

name: Spain
note: Used for Habsburg and Bourbon Spain; in the Peninsular War it means patriot Bourbon Spain, not Joseph Bonaparte's kingdom.

name: Sweden
note: Used for the Swedish Empire and Sweden (Sweden-Norway from 1814).

name: Ottoman Empire
note: Used for the Ottoman Empire.

name: England / Great Britain / United Kingdom
note: Used for England before 1707, Great Britain 1707-1800 and the UK from 1801; in Indian wars it also stands for the British East India Company.

name: United States
note: Used from 1776, before COW's 1816 start.

name: Wurttemberg
note: Duchy, then Electorate and Kingdom, of Wurttemberg.
